about_the_game:
This demo version includes 3 missions, the ability to upgrade the space station, and all basic game mechanics such as weapon customization, character equipment, inventory management, etc. At the moment, a new type of enemies is actively being developed, which will be available in future demo versions. Leave comments on this version, all suggestions and criticism will be taken into account to improve the product.

The game pays great attention to the details of equipment - armor, weapons, backpacks, a lot of grenades and other devices to achieve goals and do not forget the cartridges, without them the weapon will not shoot! Equip each fighter before landing on the mission, find equipment at locations or take it away from enemies. You can change any item of equipment right during the battle, you do not need to wait for a special moment or return to base.

The death of a fighter means the loss of equipment, some of which can be picked up by the rest of the squad if they have a place for it. Take out as many resources as possible from missions to improve the space station, this will make it possible to store more items on the base, improve characters and create consumables.

This adventure takes about 2 hours to complete, good luck finding rare loot!

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages including Violence and Strong Language. Characters die in an explosive way with blood.

short_description: Control a squad of fighters in turn-based battles. The game pays great attention to the details of equipment - weapons, backpacks, a lot of grenades and other devices. More resources taken out of the mission - more improvements at the base. There are no useless items, there is a small backpack.
